notes: The last twenty issues of the archive - November 2023 to December 2024, the whole of the archive's fourth and fifth pages. Ten are monthly Neighborhood News issues, ten are one-page meeting, election and parking notices with no historical content. This batch finishes the source: every issue the archive holds has now been read.

coverage.remaining: Nothing. All fifty issues in the archive have been read.
coverage.note: Forty-seven numbered-address mentions across the ten substantive issues. The three articles the February 2025 issue pointed back to are all here and all yielded: March and April 2024 on Denis Kearney's burned house, now the Saturn Stairway; June 2024 on the grocery at 4499 17th Street and Raisa Gorbachev's 1990 visit to it; and August 2024 on Ruth Asawa's house at 21 Saturn Street. Several mentions are somebody's address and nothing more - a plaque subject's two 17th Street flats, a hundred-year resident of Ord Court - and are left out under the privacy rule.
